mods.name: Dinocraft
mods.description: Dinocraft is a mod that contains new dinosaur and prehistoric items, blocks and mobs to the game.

releases.notes:
---General Changes---

-Updated to 1.19.3
-All dinosaurs & blocks now have sound effects for hostility, being passive, breaking, placing, etc.
-Added AI to ALL dinosaurs - will go further into detail later.
-Separated dinos into four types, "water", "air", "dino" & "big dino", each come with their own sound and AI.
-Added way more loot tables for every block and item.
-Added Dragonwood Sapling.
-Added Dragonwood Boat with Chest.
-Added Spawn Restrictions for all dinos.
-Added "Dino Spawn" parameter, allowing dinos to spawn in multiple hot biomes.
-Renamed "Incubated Dino Egg" to "Overgrown Dino Egg"
-Added Multiple New Textures.
-Added new API to make the mod run smoother on Ubuntu, Mac, and Windows devices.
-Added Dino Egg Inventory Textures
-Added Dragonwood Sign
-Made Stripping Wood Work Properly
-Sorted More Blocks into Block Families
-Added a DaggerBase to separate dagger's from swords
-Dinos wander slower
-Dragonwood is flammable
-Changed the amounts and groups that dinos spawn in
-Mixed the mod's items into the creative menu
-Fixed MANY Bugs

---AI---

"Big Dinos" (containing the Tyrannosaurus) have movement detection and are hostile. If you hide, it will find you.
"Dinos" will chase after you once in a suitable radius.
"Water" dinos are currently passive.
"Air" dinos will swoop down every so often and attack the player.
Many New Attributes

All AI is STILL experimental.

---Tyrannosaurus---

This is a BRAND NEW dino, spawning in the breakthrough.
Is in the "big dino" range, and has complex AI.
Complete with animations.

---Config---

If you download ClothConfig with Dinocraft, you can access a brand new config screen which allows you to (at the moment) turn off natural spawning of dinos, more will come soon.
The game will be unaffected without ClothConfig but you will not have these features.

---Breakthrough---

Note: The changes we have made to the breakthrough this update are EXTREMELY EXPERIMENTAL and the biome is not STABLE. If you want a stable biome, please play on the version beforehand.

Changed Breakthrough Surface API
Made Mushroom Biomes able to spawn concurrently with Breakthrough (sometimes they may spawn on the same island)
Changed Liverworts Spawning
Added Overgrown Dino Eggs to the list of features

& More
